d:
Bihar's massive infrastructure project is now ready! Presenting the Kachchi Dargah–Bidupur Six-Lane Ganga Bridge, now named *NITISH SETU.*
In this video, we take you on a complete End-to-End Drone Tour of this mega infrastructure project near Patna, Bihar. We explore the entire project, its approach roads, major interchanges, entry and exit points, toll plaza, connectivity and engineering features.
• PROJECT DETAILS:*
Project: Kachchi Dargah–Bidupur Six-Lane Ganga Bridge
New Name: Nitish Setu
Location: Patna & Vaishali, Bihar
Total Project Length: 19.76 KM
Main Ganga Bridge: 9.76 KM
